title: There Are Seashells on Top of Everest

voice.engine: kokoro-82m (onnx) — SCRATCH timing reference only, never published

lexicon.seafloor: S IY F L AO R

scenes.name: Summit limestone, fossils in the rock
450 million years ago: a shallow sea

lines.text: There are seashells on top of Mount Everest.
lines.delivery: Matter-of-fact, quietly amazed. Let 'seashells' sit for a beat.

lines.text: The summit rock is limestone, full of fossil sea creatures.
lines.delivery: Calm, explaining. Slight lift on 'sea creatures'.

lines.text: More than {450|four hundred fifty} million years ago, this was the floor of a shallow sea.
lines.delivery: Slow down: paint the picture. Warm on 'shallow sea'.

lines.text: Then India broke loose and raced north, four times faster than your fingernails grow.
lines.delivery: Energy up. A small smile on 'fingernails'.

lines.text: About {50|fifty} million years ago, it slammed into Asia.
The old seafloor crumpled and rose nearly nine kilometers.
And it's still rising, about two millimeters a year.
lines.delivery: Lighter, almost amused. Long breath after: the story turns.

lines.text: In {1924|nineteen twenty-four}, Mallory and Irvine were last seen climbing toward the top.
They never came back. In {2024|twenty twenty-four}, a boot melted out of the ice, Irvine's name stitched into the sock.
lines.delivery: Quiet. Pause after 'never came back'. Gentle on 'stitched into the sock'.

lines.text: Their camera was never found. Nobody knows if they reached the summit.
But if they did, they stood on seashells.
lines.delivery: Soft, almost a whisper, with a smile. Loops straight into 'There are seashells on top of Mount Everest.'
